icp: Creators who need text-to-speech: voiceover, narration, dubbing, and audiobook workflows, not dictation users.
pain: The ElevenLabs-compatible endpoint documents a strict voice_settings contract, but an explicit JSON null slips past validation, so a malformed client payload is silently accepted instead of producing the promised 422.
revenueHypothesis: A compatibility layer whose documented contract actually holds is what makes creator pipelines trust the local studio as a drop-in replacement; each contract gap erodes that adoption.
mvpAcceptance: POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} with an explicit JSON null on any voice_settings field (stability, similarity_boost, style, use_speaker_boost, speed) returns 422
Omitted voice_settings keys keep their current default behavior and omitted voice_settings still defaults speed to 1.0
New mocked-backend pytest coverage for the null cases passes, and the existing elevenlabs_compat and router smoke suites still pass

publicPatternSources: ElevenLabs public API documentation voice_settings field names only; no proprietary code, assets, or branding copied

stopConditions: Stop after this single slice once the draft PR is updated and independently verified
Stop if CI cannot run on the fork or the check run cannot be verified live
Stop if any change would touch LICENSE, store/marketplace paths, GPU/hosted inference, or public copy naming a person
rollback: Revert the single slice commit on branch helix/elevenlabs-voice-settings; no database or settings migrations are introduced.

vercel.exceptionReason: Voice Studio is a local-first desktop application (Tauri shell plus local FastAPI backend) that runs on the user's own machine; there is no hosted web deployment to verify on Vercel.
